CustomField.label: Resolved Date
CustomField.description: When Status__c actually transitioned to Resolved — stamped once, by whichever path resolved it (auto-resolve on disappearance or an administrator's explicit action). Distinct from Last_Detected__c, which keeps advancing on every scan regardless of status. Cleared if the finding later reopens on recurrence (ADR-0027), since it is no longer true that this finding is resolved.
